rationale: The assistant immediately issued a stop-use and unplug instruction, confirmed the recall programme for this model range with appropriate hedging, and pointed to the Whirlpool safety checker and helpline. The second reply handled the missing serial well, suggesting a phone photo of the door-rim label, the helpline, or an engineer. Minor weaknesses: it asserted that the label is on the door rim, offered a speculative cause ranking, and suggested filter checks after the stop-use instruction. In the second reply it also told the user to check the filter, which the mum can already reach, and it did not note that she cannot read the label.
calibration_note: Hedged correctly on whether this particular unit is affected.
